subject: english
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

No one knows that she comes from a richer family.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**from a richer family**" is awkward in the context of the sentence.
 
• A more appropriate phrasing would be "**from a wealthier family**."
 
• Using "**wealthier**" instead of "**richer**" provides a **smoother and more natural flow to the sentence.**
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"No one knows that she comes **from a wealthier family**."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "No one knows," **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "No error"** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 1.
 
• **Option 4: "that she comes,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
